parsed.reason: Description A says sign_out_everywhere's snapshot-then-delete races with a concurrent refresh that removes and reissues a session, so the attacker's session survives. Description B says the StoreError is caught and logged, so failed revocations are silently skipped and the caller cannot tell sign-out was incomplete. Different root causes: a race condition versus swallowed delete errors.
